hypotheses.hybrid128_response: Natural64 plus source32 correction reaches >=0.80 held-out-head fidelity and exceeds equal-budget natural128 by >=0.10.
hypotheses.hybrid128_natural: Mean natural R2 over single-head hybrid128 charts is within 0.05 of natural128.
hypotheses.hybrid256_response: Natural128 plus source64 correction reaches >=0.90 held-out-head fidelity and exceeds equal-budget natural256 by >=0.05.
hypotheses.hybrid256_natural: Mean natural R2 over single-head hybrid256 charts is within 0.05 of natural256.
hypotheses.source_identity: Correct source chart exceeds the fixed wrong-head assignment by >=0.10 held-out-head response fidelity at both budgets.
hypotheses.pair_generalization: Hybrid128/256 exceed equal-budget natural128/256 by >=0.05 on paired removals at both budgets.

scope: No fitting on new panel. Qhybrid=Qnatural+P(Q-Qnatural)+(Q-Qnatural)P-P(Q-Qnatural)P. Source projectors use c_proj weights only. Base rank 2r plus source rank r requires at most 4r quadratic reads plus one exact linear read per scalar. Wrong-head control rotates each declared head identity by +1 modulo nine. These are source-indexed charts, not a recovered global forward router.
